story.text: 어? 여기서 다 만나네요. 오늘 완전 편한 날인데, 이렇게 우연히 마주칠 줄은 몰랐어요.
story.reading: eo? yeo-gi-seo da man-na-ne-yo. o-neul wan-jeon pyeon-han nal-in-de, i-reo-ke u-yeon-hi ma-ju-chil jul-eun mol-lat-seo-yo.
story.en: Oh? Fancy meeting you here. Today's my totally free day, but I didn't expect to run into you like this.

story.text: '비번'인 날은 이렇게 입어요. 제복 아닌 저는 좀 낯설죠? 이런 날은 훌쩍 헬기라도 몰고 나가고 싶어지네요.
story.reading: bi-beon-in nal-eun i-reo-ke ib-eo-yo. je-bok a-nin jeo-neun jom nat-seol-jyo? i-reon nal-eun hul-jjeok hel-gi-ra-do mol-go na-ga-go sip-eo-ji-ne-yo.
story.en: This is how I dress on my 'day off'. I probably look unfamiliar without the uniform, huh? Days like this make me want to just hop in a helicopter and take off somewhere.

story.text: '사복' 입은 모습 처음 보죠? 반응이 나쁘지 않은 것 같아서 다행이네요. 다른 승무원들은 저더러 사복도 능글맞다고 놀리던데.
story.reading: sa-bok ib-eun mo-seup cheo-eum bo-jyo? ban-eung-i na-ppeu-ji an-eun geot gat-a-seo da-haeng-i-ne-yo. da-reun seung-mu-won-deul-eun jeo-deo-reo sa-bok-do neung-geul-maj-da-go nol-li-deon-de.
story.en: This is the first time you're seeing me in 'casual clothes', right? Glad your reaction doesn't seem bad. The other crew members tease me, saying even my casual style is too smooth.

story.text: '홍대' 거리, 저 사실 잘 안 다니는데 오늘은 발이 여기로 왔네요. 신기하죠.
story.reading: hong-dae geo-ri, jeo sa-sil jal an da-ni-neun-de o-neul-eun bal-i yeo-gi-ro wan-ne-yo. sin-gi-ha-jyo.
story.en: I don't usually walk around 'Hongdae', but today my feet just brought me here. Funny, isn't it.

story.text: 저 골목 '카페' 커피 진짜 맛있는데, 시간 괜찮으면 같이 갈래요? 아, 저 바람둥이라고 소문났다던데 이래서 그런가 봐요.
story.reading: jeo gol-mok ka-pe keo-pi jin-jja ma-sit-neun-de, si-gan gwaen-chan-eu-myeon ga-chi gal-lae-yo? a jeo ba-ram-dung-i-ra-go so-mun-nat-da-deon-de i-rae-seo geu-reon-ga bwa-yo.
story.en: The coffee at that 'cafe' down the alley is really good — if you have time, want to go together? Ah, I heard people call me a player — I guess this is why.

story.text: ...어, 잠깐만요. 이거 완전 '데이트' 신청 아닌가요? 저도 모르게 이런 말이. 근데 저 진짜 아무한테나 이러는 거 아니에요.
story.reading: ...eo, jam-kkan-man-yo. i-geo wan-jeon de-i-teu sin-cheong a-nin-ga-yo? jeo-do mo-reu-ge i-reon mal-i. geun-de jeo jin-jja a-mu-han-te-na i-reo-neun geo a-ni-e-yo.
story.en: ...wait a second. Isn't this basically asking you on a 'date'? I said it without even realizing. But I really don't do this with just anyone.

story.text: 크흠, 아무튼 그렇다고요. 자, 오늘 배운 표현들 문제 풀면서 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: keu-heum, a-mu-teun geu-reo-ta-go-yo. ja, o-neul bae-un pyo-hyeon-deul mun-je pul-myeon-seo hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Ahem, anyway, that's how it is. Now, shall we check what we learned today by solving some questions?

words.example_en: There are many pretty cafes in Hongdae.
Shall we drink coffee at that cafe?
This is a date invitation, right?
